neighbours.label: The first piece of a word split across tokens when it begins a new line or sentence ('T/oll-free', ' E/legance', 'Im/prove', 'D/ental'), and ' Re' after 'Subject:'; whole-token words in that place stay quiet.
fire:
Our staff answers calls all day.
Toll charges are listed on the site.
The kitchen is bright and clean. Elegance runs through the whole house.

Keep your records up to date.
Improve them with regular checks.

Open on weekdays only.
Dentures are repaired at the front desk.

From: Ann
Subject: Re: Lunch on Friday
The garden is quiet at noon. Wisteria climbs the old brick wall.

We fixed the leak last week.
Plumbing costs are on the bill.

Send your forms by Monday.
Enrollment closes at noon.
quiet:
Our staff answers calls all day.
The charges are listed on the site.
The kitchen is bright and clean. It runs along the whole house.

Keep your records up to date.
Check them every month.

Open on weekdays only.
Items are repaired at the front desk.

From: Ann
Subject: Lunch on Friday
The garden is quiet at noon. Birds sing on the old brick wall.

We fixed the leak last week.
Prices are on the bill.

Send your forms by Monday.
The office closes at noon.

short: first piece of a split word at a line or sentence start
notes: Probes: 0.35-0.69. Whole first tokens 0.02-0.05 (one 'He' 0.13), but 'F' in 'Fees' 0.42 at text start, so near misses need a whole-token opener. Density is about 1% of tokens, so other things may also fire. Also seen mid-sentence: 'b' in '(bassist' 0.50, not covered.
